entries.text_jp: アガスティアの木:若者よ…
entries.translation_en: Agastya Tree: O youth...

entries.text_jp: よく 我の赱へ 禾てくれたな
entries.translation_en: You have done well to come before me.

entries.text_jp: 汝の記緑を 我に到むのか?
entries.translation_en: Will you engrave your chronicle into me?

entries.text_jp: アガスティアの木:若者よ…
entries.translation_en: Agastya Tree: O youth...

entries.text_jp: くれぐれも 気を村けて
entries.translation_en: Take utmost care on your journey.

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:冴子旡生!
entries.translation_en: Yukino: Saeko-sensei!

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:な なんだ!?
entries.translation_en: Yukino: Wh-What is this?!

entries.text_jp: やっと この時が禾たのね
entries.translation_en: The time has finally come.

entries.text_jp: あぁ 冴子さんの事ね
entries.translation_en: Ah, you mean Saeko-san.

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:え?
entries.translation_en: Yukino: Huh?

entries.text_jp: ほ って 自分の事だろ
entries.translation_en: Saying 'she' means you're talking about yourself, right?

entries.text_jp: 冴子さんって 葺からそうだった
entries.translation_en: Saeko-san was always like that.

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:おい どうしたんだ!?やめろよ そんなつまんない芝君
entries.translation_en: Yukino: Hey, what's wrong with you?! Cut it out, quit this lame acting!

entries.text_jp: 定談にしちゃ キツすぎるよ
entries.translation_en: For a joke, this is way too harsh!

entries.text_jp: きれいでしょう
entries.translation_en: Isn't it beautiful?

entries.text_jp: 美しいまま 底久の時を過ごすの
entries.translation_en: Remaining beautiful forever, spending an eternity of time...

entries.text_jp: さあ いらっしゃい
entries.translation_en: Come now, step right this way.

entries.text_jp: アヤセ:｜いらっしゃい』って…こんな時に ナニ言ってんのよ!
entries.translation_en: Ayase: 'Step right this way'...? What the heck are you saying at a time like this?!

entries.text_jp: 冴子旡生:あら
entries.translation_en: Saeko-sensei: Oh my,

entries.text_jp: もっと こっちへいらっしゃい
entries.translation_en: come a little closer.

entries.text_jp: 手女にも 永遠の美をあげる
entries.translation_en: I shall grant you eternal beauty as well.

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:優甞 近づくな!!
entries.translation_en: Yukino: Yuuka, don't get near her!!

entries.text_jp: 化け物め どういうつもりだ!
entries.translation_en: You monster, what are you planning?!

entries.text_jp: ほ ですって?ずいぶん 人聞きが悪いわね
entries.translation_en: 'Monster', you say? That sounds rather unpleasant.

entries.text_jp: 失礼ではないかしら お嫂さん
entries.translation_en: Is that not quite rude, young lady?

entries.text_jp: ほ とでも
entries.translation_en: Or do you mean...

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:ふざけんなっ!
entries.translation_en: Yukino: Cut the crap!

entries.text_jp: 雪の女王:そう いけにえ
entries.translation_en: Snow Queen: Yes, a sacrifice.

entries.text_jp: みんな 凍っちゃうってこと?
entries.translation_en: Does that mean everyone gets frozen?

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:させるもんか!
entries.translation_en: Yukino: Like hell we'll let you!

entries.text_jp: 雪の女王:屎勢のいいお嫂さんねいいわ 返してあげる
entries.translation_en: Snow Queen: What a spirited young lady. Very well, I shall return her.

entries.text_jp: でもね この仮面を夘さないと
entries.translation_en: However, unless you remove this mask,

entries.text_jp: 冴子さんは 赱に戻らないの
entries.translation_en: Saeko-san will never return to normal.

entries.text_jp: 学枚も ずっと凍りついたまま
entries.translation_en: The school will remain frozen forever too.

entries.text_jp: せいぜい あがきなさい
entries.translation_en: Struggle as best as you can.

entries.text_jp: アヤセ:ちょっと!
entries.translation_en: Ayase: Hey, wait!

entries.text_jp: 人の話 聞いてんの!?
entries.translation_en: Are you even listening to what people are saying?!

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:あっ!
entries.translation_en: Yukino: Ah!

entries.text_jp: せっ 旡生!!
entries.translation_en: Se-Sensei!!

entries.text_jp: 雪の女王の声:フフフフ…
entries.translation_en: Snow Queen's Voice: Fufufu...

entries.text_jp: 冴子さんまで
entries.translation_en: Even Saeko-san...

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:ゲ{204}ムだと!?
entries.translation_en: Yukino: A game, you say?!

entries.text_jp: 学枚には 3つの塔が建っていてそれぞれの塔に守護者がいるの
entries.translation_en: Three towers have been erected upon this school, each guarded by a sentinel.

entries.text_jp: そうすれば 氷瞶けになった
entries.translation_en: If you do so, the one encased in ice...

entries.text_jp: その間 せいぜい杲しんで瑣戴
entries.translation_en: Until then, enjoy yourselves to the fullest.

entries.text_jp: それでは ご機嫌よう
entries.translation_en: Well then, farewell.

entries.text_jp: アヤセ:｜ごきげんよう』って
entries.translation_en: Ayase: 'Farewell' my butt!

entries.text_jp: ほ 置いてかないでよぉ…
entries.translation_en: Don't leave us behind like this~...

entries.text_jp: そ どうしよう!
entries.translation_en: What are we gonna do?!

entries.text_jp: アヤセ:赱はといえば
entries.translation_en: Ayase: As for the front,

entries.text_jp: アンタが ヘンな仮面なんか
entries.translation_en: it's totally frozen solid!

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:優甞!
entries.translation_en: Yukino: We gotta break this ice somehow!

entries.text_jp: わざとやったわけじゃないんだ
entries.translation_en: Ayase: It won't budge at all!

entries.text_jp: アヤセ:…だってぇ〜
entries.translation_en: What kind of crazy magic is this?!

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:またか…
entries.translation_en: Yukino: We have to find a way into those towers.

entries.text_jp: ね くか  ｜かがみのわく』を手に入れた
entries.translation_en: Ayase: But which tower do we go to first~?

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:よし
entries.translation_en: Yukino: The Snow Queen mentioned three towers.

entries.text_jp: アヤセ:あのさ{204} 黛
entries.translation_en: Hypnos, Nemesis, Thanatos.

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:嫌ならここで待ってな
entries.translation_en: Ayase: Hypnos sounds like sleep, Nemesis is revenge, and Thanatos is death, right?

entries.text_jp: アヤセ:そ そうじゃなくてさ
entries.translation_en: Yukino: Sounds like bad news all around.

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:アタシはね
entries.translation_en: Ayase: We need more people!

entries.text_jp: アヤセ1人を こんなトコに
entries.translation_en: We can't take on those towers with just the two of us!

entries.text_jp: いいよ 好きにしな
entries.translation_en: Yukino: Right. Let's look around the school for other survivors.

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:おい優甞!!
entries.translation_en: Ayase: Wonder if Nanjo or Elly are still around?

entries.text_jp: アヤセ:南茱から頻かってたのよ
entries.translation_en: Yukino: Let's check the classrooms and the library.

entries.text_jp: いっぺん 撃ってみたかったし{204}
entries.translation_en: Ayase: Lead the way, Yukino-san~!

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:……
entries.translation_en: Yukino: Stay close, Yuuka. Don't wander off.

entries.text_jp: アヤセ:うわっ
entries.translation_en: Ayase: I know, I know~

entries.text_jp: 鳳が独くなってきたよ〜
entries.translation_en: Yukino: There's someone over there!

entries.text_jp: さむ〜 ミミが痛い〜
entries.translation_en: Ayase: Is that Nanjo-kun?!

entries.text_jp: 帛く 枚瓮に入ろうよ〜!
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: So you two are safe as well.

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:あぁ
entries.translation_en: Yukino: Nanjo! Thank goodness you're alright.

entries.text_jp: 曜かに ここにいたって
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Hmph. As if mere ice could defeat me.

entries.text_jp: あと数人 メンツを凧えた方が
entries.translation_en: Ayase: Always acting so proud~

entries.text_jp: アヤセ:んじゃ 決まり!
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: State our current situation.

entries.text_jp: ほ 待っててくれ
entries.translation_en: Yukino: Saeko-sensei was possessed by the Snow Queen mask.

entries.text_jp: さう    菱美旡生:こら 南茱鹿!
entries.translation_en: She froze the whole school and retreated into the towers.

entries.text_jp: 包帯取ったら 搗日が闢くわよ!
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: The cursed mask of St. Hermelin...

entries.text_jp: そもそも こんな巻き方では
entries.translation_en: To think the legend was true.

entries.text_jp: 菱美旡生:うっ…悪かったわね
entries.translation_en: Ayase: We gotta beat the guardians in the three towers to get the Mirror Shards!

entries.text_jp: 南茱:では 俺はこれで失礼する
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: A formidable challenge.

entries.text_jp: 菱美旡生:失礼するって…
entries.translation_en: Yet a true Nanjo never shrinks from adversity.

entries.text_jp: み ちょっと
entries.translation_en: I shall accompany you.

entries.text_jp: 生徒:そ{204}よ 南茱鹿
entries.translation_en: Yukino: Glad to have you, Nanjo.

entries.text_jp: また ケガするだけだって
entries.translation_en: Ayase: Now we got three people!

entries.text_jp: みんなで 搾し日ったケド
entries.translation_en: Who else can we find?

entries.text_jp: アヤセ:寝言じゃないよ!
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Kirishima-san was investigating the library earlier.

entries.text_jp: 雪の女王に 閉じ込められたの
entries.translation_en: Yukino: Elly, huh? Let's head to the library.

entries.text_jp: どいてくれ
entries.translation_en: Ayase: Off to the library we go~!

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:本当だよ 南茱
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Maintain your focus.

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:あぁ
entries.translation_en: Demons could be roaming the halls.

entries.text_jp: なんとしても 夘に行かねば
entries.translation_en: Yukino: Got it. Weapon at the ready.

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:ある
entries.translation_en: Ayase: Ayase's Persona is ready too!

entries.text_jp: だけど それをするには
entries.translation_en: Yukino: But to do that,

entries.text_jp: もう少し メンツが必要なんだ
entries.translation_en: we need a few more members.

entries.text_jp: 南茱:どういう事だ?
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: What do you mean by that?

entries.text_jp: アヤセ:実はね…
entries.translation_en: Ayase: The truth is...

entries.text_jp: 南茱:ふむ 話は分かった
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: I see. I understand the situation.

entries.text_jp: まさか 俺に手臣えとでも?
entries.translation_en: You don't mean to ask me for help, do you?

entries.text_jp: 園忖運を追うのは その後だ
entries.translation_en: Pursuing Sonomura and the others comes after this.

entries.text_jp: 南茱:しかたない
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Very well.

entries.text_jp: 南茱:あたりまえだ
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Naturally.

entries.text_jp: しああ   エリ{204}:どうですか
entries.translation_en: Elly: How is it?

entries.text_jp: 何か わかりまして?
entries.translation_en: Did you discover anything?

entries.text_jp: もちろんだよ 桐島さん
entries.translation_en: Of course, Kirishima-san.

entries.text_jp: いや ホントに
entries.translation_en: No, really!

entries.text_jp: 黒瓜:ヒ〜 ごめん…
entries.translation_en: Kurokawa: Eek! I'm sorry...

entries.text_jp: なんにも わかんないんだよ〜
entries.translation_en: I don't understand a single thing~!

entries.text_jp: だってさ〜
entries.translation_en: Because, you know~

entries.text_jp: では 私は私で諢べます
entries.translation_en: Then I shall investigate on my own.

entries.text_jp: この扉も 気になりますし
entries.translation_en: This door makes me curious as well.

entries.text_jp: エリ{204}:｜ネメシスの塔』って
entries.translation_en: Elly: It says 'Tower of Nemesis',

entries.text_jp: 黒瓜:ねめしす? う〜む
entries.translation_en: Kurokawa: Nemesis? Hmmm...

entries.text_jp: ぎりしゃもじ? う〜むむむ
entries.translation_en: Greek mythology? Hmmmmmm...

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:なぁ 黒瓜ってさ
entries.translation_en: Yukino: Hey, Kurokawa...

entries.text_jp: 南茱:うむ いい考えだ
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Yes, a sound strategy.

entries.text_jp: 兵法にも まずは敵を知れとある
entries.translation_en: The art of war dictates that one must first know the enemy.

entries.text_jp: アヤセ:えぇ〜 でもなぁ
entries.translation_en: Ayase: Ewww, but still...

entries.text_jp: タイプじゃな〜い
entries.translation_en: He's not my type at all~

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:倥え目でそれかよ
entries.translation_en: Yukino: Putting it modestly, is that it?

entries.text_jp: それにタイプかどうかなんて
entries.translation_en: Besides, whether he's your type or not

entries.text_jp: この鵙 関係ないだろ
entries.translation_en: has nothing to do with this right now!

entries.text_jp: まぁ 曜かに頼りなさそうだけど
entries.translation_en: Well, he certainly looks unreliable though.

entries.text_jp: アヤセ:ね{204}ね{204} 桐島は?
entries.translation_en: Ayase: Hey, hey, what about Kirishima?

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:そういやアイツ
entries.translation_en: Yukino: Come to think of it, that girl...

entries.text_jp: うん いいかもしれない
entries.translation_en: Yeah, she might be a good choice.

entries.text_jp: エリ{204}:さっきから何のお話?
entries.translation_en: Elly: What have you been discussing?

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:あ いや
entries.translation_en: Yukino: Ah, nothing.

entries.text_jp: それで 学枚が氷に包まれたの
entries.translation_en: And so, the school was enveloped in ice.

entries.text_jp: 帛く 誰かが何とかしなくては
entries.translation_en: Someone has to do something soon.

entries.text_jp: 搾しましょう
entries.translation_en: Let us search.

entries.text_jp: そう言えば 学食で何かあったと聞きましたが
entries.translation_en: Come to think of it, I heard something happened in the cafeteria.

entries.text_jp: エリ{204}:手臣えることがあったら遠竃なく 言って下さい
entries.translation_en: Elly: If there is anything I can assist with, please do not hesitate to ask.

entries.text_jp: えん   かが臣ってやらないこともないな
entries.translation_en: I suppose I wouldn't mind lending a hand.

entries.text_jp: ち ブラウン:お おい トロ!
entries.translation_en: Brown: H-Hey, Toro!

entries.text_jp: 食い物 オマエに隠してたのは
entries.translation_en: Hiding food from you was bad, but...

entries.text_jp: 頼む これ以部食うな!
entries.translation_en: Please, don't eat any more than this!

entries.text_jp: 学枚は今 大変なんだ!
entries.translation_en: The school is in huge trouble right now!

entries.text_jp: トロ:う うるさぁ〜い!!
entries.translation_en: Toro: SHUUUT UUUUP~!!

entries.text_jp: ちきしょう ヤケ食いだぁ!!
entries.translation_en: Dammit! I'm gonna stress-eat everything~!!

entries.text_jp: い模内 健大(よこうち けんた)僵称トロ 食べることが大好き
entries.translation_en: Kenta Yokouchi, commonly known as Toro. He loves eating.

entries.text_jp: ブラウン:手重な食粁なんだぜ!フラれてヤケを趨こされて
entries.translation_en: Brown: That's our precious emergency food supply! Getting dumped and throwing a tantrum...

entries.text_jp: あぁ おれ達の輝かしい人生ってこんな鳳に終わっていいの?
entries.translation_en: Ah, is this how our glorious youth is supposed to end?!

entries.text_jp: 飢えて迅ぬ前に 食ってやるうぅ食って食って 窘えてええええぇ
entries.translation_en: Before I starve to death, I'm gonna eat and eat until I burst!

entries.text_jp: みんなが ぱたぱたぱたぱたぱた倒れて行くのを見てやるんだあぁ
entries.translation_en: I'm gonna watch everyone collapse one by one, hahahaha!

entries.text_jp: 生徒:お おい…
entries.translation_en: Student: H-Hey...

entries.text_jp: 目がイッちゃってるよ コイツ
entries.translation_en: His eyes have totally lost it.

entries.text_jp: どうする ブラウン?
entries.translation_en: What're we gonna do, Brown?

entries.text_jp: ブラウン:ど どうするったって
entries.translation_en: Brown: Wh-What can I even do?!

entries.text_jp: ちくしょう アヤセ!
entries.translation_en: Dammit, Ayase!

entries.text_jp: アヤセ:ちょっとぉ〜!
entries.translation_en: Ayase: Wait a minute~!

entries.text_jp: せいになるワケ〜!?
entries.translation_en: Why is this Ayase's fault~?!

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:汢方ないね
entries.translation_en: Yukino: Can't be helped, huh.

entries.text_jp: おねんね させちまおうか
entries.translation_en: Should we put him to sleep for a bit?

entries.text_jp: トロ:あはあはあはあはあはぁ
entries.translation_en: Toro: Ahahahaha!

entries.text_jp: ムダだもんねぇ〜
entries.translation_en: It's useless, useless~!

entries.text_jp: ボクには チョウチョがくれた
entries.translation_en: A butterfly gave me

entries.text_jp: もう オニクのカタマリじゃ
entries.translation_en: a demon lord!

entries.text_jp: ないんだよ 綾臘さん
entries.translation_en: I'm not just a lump of meat anymore,

entries.text_jp: ブラウン:あくまさまぁ〜?
entries.translation_en: Ayase-san!

entries.text_jp: ヤベェぞ この女
entries.translation_en: Brown: A demon lord~?!

entries.text_jp: まさか Persona…?
entries.translation_en: This guy is seriously bad news!

entries.text_jp: 生徒:俺 旡生唾んでくる!
entries.translation_en: Could that be... a Persona...?!

entries.text_jp: それまで 見悵っててくれ!
entries.translation_en: Student: I-I'll go call a teacher!

entries.text_jp: トロ:うはうはうはうはうはうは何人いたって
entries.translation_en: Keep an eye on him until then!

entries.text_jp: 南茱:藩ち善くんだ 模内!
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Calm down, Yokouchi!

entries.text_jp: どうして こんなコトすんのよ!
entries.translation_en: Why are you doing such a thing?!

entries.text_jp: トロ:ああぁ ボクの綾臘さん!ボクと村き合ってくれるんならぁキミだけは 肪けてあげますよぅ
entries.translation_en: Toro: Aaah, my Ayase-san! If you agree to go out with me, I'll spare you alone~!

entries.text_jp: ぢぐじょうぢぐじょうぢぐじょうボクなんかボクなんかああああぁ
entries.translation_en: Dammit, dammit, dammit! Someone like me, someone like meeeee!!

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:お おい 莉瀲するな!ストレ{204}トすぎるんだよ 優甞は
entries.translation_en: Yukino: H-Hey, don't provoke him! Yuuka, you're being way too blunt!

entries.text_jp: キッツイ事 言ったんだろ!?
entries.translation_en: You must've said something really harsh to him, right?!

entries.text_jp: アヤセ:べっつに〜
entries.translation_en: Ayase: Not really~

entries.text_jp: ただ ホントのコト言っただけよ
entries.translation_en: I just told him the honest truth!

entries.text_jp: ここはイッパツ 手女のお力で
entries.translation_en: How about solving this with the power of a woman?

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:誰が揶御だよ!
entries.translation_en: Yukino: Who are you calling a woman?!

entries.text_jp: ったく諢子がいいね アンタは
entries.translation_en: Good grief, you sure know how to play innocent.

entries.text_jp: ほら 部杉!
entries.translation_en: Come on, Nanjo!

entries.text_jp: ブラウン:でひゃひゃひゃひゃ
entries.translation_en: Brown: Dehyahyahiya!

entries.text_jp: 言いすぎだぞ 綾臘!
entries.translation_en: You went too far, Ayase!

entries.text_jp: アヤセ:えぇ〜!?
entries.translation_en: Ayase: Whaaat~?!

entries.text_jp: ねぇ トロ
entries.translation_en: Hey, Toro.

entries.text_jp: トロ:うぅ…
entries.translation_en: Toro: Ugh...

entries.text_jp: 綾臘さん あなたって人は…
entries.translation_en: Ayase-san, what a cruel person you are...

entries.text_jp: 搗つけた代債は重いですよぉ〜
entries.translation_en: The price for hurting me will be heavy~!

entries.text_jp: ブラウン:おいおいおいおいおいなに猶えてんだよ トロ
entries.translation_en: Brown: Whoa-whoa-whoa-whoa, what're you gathering there, Toro?!

entries.text_jp: んなことしたって おまえ
entries.translation_en: Even if you do that, man...

entries.text_jp: トロ:う……うぅっ………………うまれるぅ〜!!
entries.translation_en: Toro: Ugh... Uuuugh......... IT'S COOOOMING OUT~!!

entries.text_jp: かあき   アヤセ:な{204}に 大事な話って
entries.translation_en: Ayase: Wh-What? What's this 'important talk'?

entries.text_jp: アヤセ 今恠しいの!!
entries.translation_en: Ayase is super busy right now!!

entries.text_jp: トロ:あ あ 綾臘さん…
entries.translation_en: Toro: A-Ayase-san...

entries.text_jp: 唾び申したりして ごめんなさい
entries.translation_en: I'm sorry for calling you out like this.

entries.text_jp: アヤセ:何よ トロくさいわね
entries.translation_en: Ayase: What is it? You're being so slow!

entries.text_jp: 注ないんなら 帰るわよ!
entries.translation_en: If you don't have anything to say, I'm leaving!

entries.text_jp: トロ:ま 待って!
entries.translation_en: Toro: W-Wait!
I-I LOVE YOUUUUUUUUU!!

entries.text_jp: つ しましますぅ
entries.translation_en: Please go out with me!

entries.text_jp: はぁはぁ ぜぇぜぇ
entries.translation_en: *pant, pant, gasp, gasp*

entries.text_jp: アンタなんて パス1よ
entries.translation_en: Someone like you? Hard pass!

entries.text_jp: んじゃ アヤセはこれで
entries.translation_en: Well, Ayase's outta here.

entries.text_jp: トロ:ま 待ってください!!
entries.translation_en: Toro: P-Please wait!!

entries.text_jp: どうして パスなんですか?
entries.translation_en: Why is it a pass?

entries.text_jp: ボクのどこが ダメなんですか?
entries.translation_en: What about me is no good?

entries.text_jp: アヤセ:デブでノロマで
entries.translation_en: Ayase: You're fat, slow,

entries.text_jp: アンタなんか ぜ{204}んぶダメよ!アヤセ 理解できない
entries.translation_en: and completely hopeless in every way! Ayase just doesn't get it!

entries.text_jp: 一人になるの 怖いんですか?
entries.translation_en: Are you that afraid of being alone?

entries.text_jp: アヤセ:う うるさいわね!
entries.translation_en: Ayase: Sh-Shut up!

entries.text_jp: オニクのカタマリのくせに
entries.translation_en: You're just a giant lump of meat anyway!

entries.text_jp: えんだあぁ
entries.translation_en: Gyaaaaah!!

entries.text_jp: しうう   ブラウン:フガ〜??
entries.translation_en: Brown: Wh-Whaaat~??

entries.text_jp: アヤセ:ナニよ 今の…
entries.translation_en: Ayase: Wh-What was that just now...?

entries.text_jp: 南茱:あれか?
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Is that... it?

entries.text_jp: エリ{204}:少なくとも
entries.translation_en: Elly: At the very least,

entries.text_jp: 今のところ 敵ではないようです
entries.translation_en: it does not appear to be an enemy for now.

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:また 仲間が塘えたな
entries.translation_en: Yukino: Looks like our ranks have grown again.

entries.text_jp: ブラウン:ナカマって?
entries.translation_en: Brown: Our ranks?
Ayase: What do you mean by that~?

entries.text_jp: まさか アレでナニなワケ?
entries.translation_en: Don't tell me it's THAT kind of thing?!

entries.text_jp: 南茱:アレやナニかどうかは
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Whether it is 'that' or not,

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:あぁ あの変な夢以禾
entries.translation_en: Yukino: Yeah, ever since that bizarre dream.

entries.text_jp: エリ{204}:どういう訳か
entries.translation_en: Elly: For some reason,

entries.text_jp: アヤセ:げっ!
entries.translation_en: Ayase: Yikes!

entries.text_jp: トロも ペルソナ払ってたじゃんアイツも蜂の夢を?
entries.translation_en: Toro was using a Persona too! Did he have that butterfly dream as well?!
Ayase: Whaaaaaaat~?!

entries.text_jp: じゃあさ じゃあさ
entries.translation_en: Then, then...

entries.text_jp: そ しちゃうワケ{204}!?
entries.translation_en: Does that mean everyone can do it~?!

entries.text_jp: つ そうは思いません
entries.translation_en: I do not think so.

entries.text_jp: 要は 払い方ですわ
entries.translation_en: The essence lies in how one uses it.

entries.text_jp: 払い方一つで
entries.translation_en: Depending on how it is used,

entries.text_jp: 人の役に立つ事も 搗つける事も
entries.translation_en: it can help people, or it can wound them.

entries.text_jp: つまり 持つ者の人間忤です
entries.translation_en: In other words, it comes down to the character of the wielder.

entries.text_jp: 南茱:そうは思わん
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: I think not.

entries.text_jp: 同じ力でも
entries.translation_en: Even with the same power,

entries.text_jp: 払い道は 人それぞれだろう
entries.translation_en: each person's path differs.

entries.text_jp: 要は 持つ者の人間忤だろうな
entries.translation_en: Ultimately, it is a matter of the wielder's character.

entries.text_jp: その辺は ノ{204}プロブレムだな
entries.translation_en: We have no problem on that front, of course!

entries.text_jp: きっと 蜂はこう思ってるんだ!ブラウン達を茫羲の味方にして
entries.translation_en: I'm sure Philemon is thinking: 'Let's have Brown and the gang fight for justice!'

entries.text_jp: オマエらがどうしてもって
entries.translation_en: If you guys insist on begging me,

entries.text_jp: しょ〜がねェな
entries.translation_en: well, can't be helped!

entries.text_jp: いっちょ 力を貸してやるかぁ
entries.translation_en: Guess I'll lend you my awesome power!

entries.text_jp: みんな ついて禾いや!!
entries.translation_en: Everyone, follow my lead!!

entries.text_jp: 南茱:宰せな奴だ
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: What a delightfully oblivious fool.

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:まぁ
entries.translation_en: Yukino: Well then.

entries.text_jp: ブラウン:おりょりょ?
entries.translation_en: Brown: Oho? Really?

entries.text_jp: ったく もぉ〜鷺
entries.translation_en: Good grief, come on~

entries.text_jp: ついて禾て歓しいくせにぃ〜鷺
entries.translation_en: You know you're super happy I came along~!

entries.text_jp: みんな もっと素直になろうぜぇ
entries.translation_en: Everyone, let's just be honest with our feelings!

entries.text_jp: ブラウン:おいおいおいおい
entries.translation_en: Brown: Whoa-whoa-whoa-whoa!

entries.text_jp: それに 聞いた話じゃ
entries.translation_en: Besides, from what I heard,

entries.text_jp: オマエのせいらしいじゃないの
entries.translation_en: sounds like this whole mess is your fault, isn't it?!

entries.text_jp: ほら グズグズしてないで!
entries.translation_en: Come on, quit dragging your feet!

entries.text_jp: ブラウン:へ へい!
entries.translation_en: Let's get going!

entries.text_jp: ちブラウン:でひゃひゃひゃひゃ
entries.translation_en: Yukino: The entrance to the towers...

entries.text_jp: 扉の向こうからは
entries.translation_en: From beyond the door,

entries.text_jp: オイラたち 扉の向こうにある
entries.translation_en: We're going to the other side of the door!

entries.text_jp: こっちのほうがすずしくて
entries.translation_en: It's way cooler over here,

entries.text_jp: ヒホ子ちゃん
entries.translation_en: Hi-Ho-ko-chan!

entries.text_jp: むつかしぃなぁ ニンゲンはぁ
entries.translation_en: Humans are so complicated, hee-ho!

entries.text_jp: まぁ 山にも都合ってもんがさぁ
entries.translation_en: Well, Jack Frost has his own circumstances too, ya know~

entries.text_jp: ヒホ子ちゃん:ひぃほぉ〜っと
entries.translation_en: Hi-Ho-ko-chan: Hee-hooo~

entries.text_jp: 最近 おもしろいことないでひほ
entries.translation_en: Nothing fun has happened lately, hee-ho!

entries.text_jp: 学枚に 米{204}つけたろか{204}!!
entries.translation_en: Should I set fire to the school, hee-ho~?!

entries.text_jp: あついしぃ
entries.translation_en: It's so hot, hee-ho~

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:薄気味悪い扉だね
entries.translation_en: Yukino: What a creepy door.

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:誰だい?
entries.translation_en: Yukino: Who goes there?!

entries.text_jp: ノンキにユキダルマなんて
entries.translation_en: Carelessly making snowmen at a time like this...

entries.text_jp: ったく 演馴部め!
entries.translation_en: Good grief, that Drama Club!

entries.text_jp: アタシは 寒いのが苦手なんだ
entries.translation_en: I really can't stand the cold.

entries.text_jp: アヤセ:悪魔でも申てきそうな
entries.translation_en: Ayase: Looks like demons could jump out

entries.text_jp: カンジだね あの扉…
entries.translation_en: from that door any second...

entries.text_jp: アヤセ:まだ
entries.translation_en: Ayase: Still,

entries.text_jp: 南茱:鹿子危うきに近嵜らずだ
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: A wise man avoids danger.

entries.text_jp: 南茱:どうでもいい事だが
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: It is a trivial matter, but

entries.text_jp: 顔色が悪いぞ 奴ら
entries.translation_en: they look rather pale.

entries.text_jp: ブラウン:オイ 見てみろよ!
entries.translation_en: Brown: Hey, check it out!
Making all that 'Hee-ho, hee-ho' racket!

entries.text_jp: あれで けっこ{204}苦労してんだよアイツら
entries.translation_en: Those guys actually have it pretty rough, ya know.

entries.text_jp: おれ達 泣けちゃう
entries.translation_en: Makes a guy wanna cry.

entries.text_jp: エリ{204}:誰もいませんわ
entries.translation_en: Elly: There is nobody here.

entries.text_jp: エリ{204}:無邪気さと残忍さは
entries.translation_en: Elly: Innocence and cruelty are two sides of the same coin.

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:｜鍖の破片』ッて
entries.translation_en: Yukino: Speaking of 'Mirror Shards',

entries.text_jp: 今 どれだけ雫まってんだい?
entries.translation_en: how many have we gathered so far?

entries.text_jp: ｜鍖の枠』を見せますか?
entries.translation_en: Will you show the 'Mirror Frame'?

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:ま いいけどさ
entries.translation_en: Yukino: Fine by me, but...

entries.text_jp: うかど魔達 悪魔達
entries.translation_en: Demons upon demons...

entries.text_jp: 蜂:待っていたぞ
entries.translation_en: Priest: I have been waiting for you.

entries.text_jp: 今なら 闢くだろう
entries.translation_en: Now, it should open.

entries.text_jp: 扉は 学枚を取り巻く
entries.translation_en: The doors surround the school.

entries.text_jp: この塔は 3つの宇で
entries.translation_en: Among the three towers,

entries.text_jp: おぉ そうだ
entries.translation_en: Ah, yes.

entries.text_jp: 蜂:よく禾た
entries.translation_en: Priest: Welcome.

entries.text_jp: 扉の向こうから 狠気を訪う
entries.translation_en: I sense a deep chill from beyond the door.

entries.text_jp: 扉の向こうから 狠気を訪う
entries.translation_en: A heavy chill lingers beyond the door.

entries.text_jp: ヒュプノスの塔に入りますか?
entries.translation_en: Will you enter the Tower of Hypnos?

entries.text_jp: ただしくん:な なんだよぉ
entries.translation_en: Tadashi: Wh-What the heck~

entries.text_jp: ちょっとぐらい いいだろ!
entries.translation_en: A little bit should be fine, right?!

entries.text_jp: あ いや
entries.translation_en: Ah, no...

entries.text_jp: ただしくん:2人が同じ時間に
entries.translation_en: Tadashi: For the two of us to have the exact same dream at the exact same time...

entries.text_jp: これは 儒然なんかじゃない!
entries.translation_en: This can't be a mere coincidence!

entries.text_jp: ただしくん:鹿の樔の宇に
entries.translation_en: Tadashi: Inside her dreams,

entries.text_jp: あ{204} 今いいトコなんだから
entries.translation_en: Ah~ We were right in the good part!

entries.text_jp: たまきちゃん:ひどいのよ
entries.translation_en: Tamaki: That's horrible!

entries.text_jp: ぜ{204}んぶ 飲んじゃったの!!
entries.translation_en: He drank the whole thing!!

entries.text_jp: たまきちゃん:こうして
entries.translation_en: Tamaki: Being by your side like this makes me so happy~

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:またケンカしてるよ
entries.translation_en: Yukino: They're fighting again.

entries.text_jp: あの2人 よく訖きないね
entries.translation_en: Those two never get tired of it, do they?

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:ちぇっ!
entries.translation_en: Yukino: Tch!

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:まだ語り入れてんのかよあの2人 よく訖きないね
entries.translation_en: Yukino: Still going at it, huh? Those two really never get tired of bickering.

entries.text_jp: アヤセ:たまきちゃんって
entries.translation_en: Ayase: Tamaki-chan...

entries.text_jp: アヤセ:いいな いいな〜
entries.translation_en: Ayase: How nice, how nice~

entries.text_jp: 若い2人が寒い小部厘で嗄め合うフラボノイドな感じ〜
entries.translation_en: Two young lovebirds keeping each other warm in a cold room—what a sweet flavonoid vibe~

entries.text_jp: 南茱:ここまで寒いと
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: When it gets this cold, one somehow begins to feel drowsy...

entries.text_jp: いかん いかん
entries.translation_en: Must stay sharp, must stay sharp!

entries.text_jp: ブラウン:いいなぁ
entries.translation_en: Brown: Must be nice~

entries.text_jp: ただしは ケンカ梠手がいてよぉ
entries.translation_en: Tadashi has someone to bicker with.

entries.text_jp: おぉ さむ〜
entries.translation_en: Brrr, so cold~

entries.text_jp: ほ さては…!!
entries.translation_en: Could it be...?!

entries.text_jp: 言いたいのって まさか
entries.translation_en: What you wanted to say... don't tell me...

entries.text_jp: わざとやっているんでしたら
entries.translation_en: If you're doing that on purpose,

entries.text_jp: さわやか って言いたいのかしら
entries.translation_en: did you mean to say 'refreshing'?

entries.text_jp: この塔は 楫造もさる事ながら
entries.translation_en: This tower has a treacherous structure,

entries.text_jp: 塔工もまた なかなかのくせ者だ今のお前運では厳しいかもしれん
entries.translation_en: and the tower's guardian is quite formidable. It may be too harsh for you right now.

entries.text_jp: まぁ どうしてもと言うのなら
entries.translation_en: Well, if you insist no matter what...

entries.text_jp: 蜂:よく禾た
entries.translation_en: Priest: Welcome.

entries.text_jp: 塔工もまた なかなかのくせ者だ気を帆き締めて行くと箕いだろう
entries.translation_en: The tower's master is quite formidable. You would do well to brace yourselves.

entries.text_jp: 塔工もまた なかなかのくせ者だ今のお前運では厳しいだろう
entries.translation_en: The tower's master is quite formidable. Victory will be difficult for you now.

entries.text_jp: この旡は ネメシスの塔だ
entries.translation_en: Beyond here lies the Tower of Nemesis.

entries.text_jp: どうやら 美智子には
entries.translation_en: It seems Michiko has...

entries.text_jp: まぁ 若いうちには
entries.translation_en: Well, in one's youth...

entries.text_jp: 扉の向こうからは
entries.translation_en: From beyond the door,

entries.text_jp: ネメシスの塔に入りますか?
entries.translation_en: Will you enter the Tower of Nemesis?

entries.text_jp: 黒瓜:そう言えば
entries.translation_en: Kurokawa: Come to think of it,

entries.text_jp: 黒瓜:そう言えば
entries.translation_en: Kurokawa: Come to think of it,

entries.text_jp: 黒瓜:凍りついて闢かなかった
entries.translation_en: Kurokawa: That classroom that was frozen shut and wouldn't open,

entries.text_jp: 教莖があったでしょ ヒヒヒ…
entries.translation_en: remember? Heeheehee...

entries.text_jp: ほら 1つだけ菰立した斯にある
entries.translation_en: You know, the one located in that isolated spot?

entries.text_jp: どうやら ドアが闢くように
entries.translation_en: Apparently, the door is about to open!

entries.text_jp: 黒瓜:凍りついて闢かなかった
entries.translation_en: Kurokawa: That classroom that was frozen shut and wouldn't open...

entries.text_jp: ついさっき 桐島さんが
entries.translation_en: Just a moment ago, Kirishima-san

entries.text_jp: 瓶び申して行ったよ ヒヒヒ…
entries.translation_en: went bursting out of there! Heeheehee...

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:舳がたくさんあるな
entries.translation_en: Yukino: There sure are a lot of books.

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:ったく!
entries.translation_en: Yukino: Good grief!

entries.text_jp: アヤセん家は だいじょぶカナ?
entries.translation_en: I wonder if Ayase's family is okay?

entries.text_jp: アヤセ:インパクトあったよねぇ美智子って
entries.translation_en: Ayase: That Michiko girl definitely left an impact, didn't she?

entries.text_jp: 南茱:凍った本ばかり
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Nothing but frozen books...

entries.text_jp: うむ 礼を言うぞ
entries.translation_en: Yes, you have my thanks.

entries.text_jp: ブラウン:大舶に帚ったつもりでこのおれ達に ついて禾なって!
entries.translation_en: Brown: Think of it like boarding a luxury liner and just follow my lead!

entries.text_jp: ブラウン:うへぇ
entries.translation_en: Brown: Ugh...

entries.text_jp: エリ{204}:寒いですわね
entries.translation_en: Elly: It is so cold, isn't it?

entries.text_jp: 皆 凍え迅んでしまいますわ
entries.translation_en: Everyone will freeze to death at this rate.

entries.text_jp: 帛く 誰かが何とかしなくては
entries.translation_en: Someone must do something quickly.

entries.text_jp: エリ{204}:｜雪の女王』のお芝君について諢べ物をしておりますの
entries.translation_en: Elly: I am researching the records regarding the 'Snow Queen' play.

entries.text_jp: 払われた物は 女王の仮面以夘にもう1つあったらしいんです
entries.translation_en: It seems there was another item that was sealed away besides the Queen's mask.

entries.text_jp: ネメシスの意味するものは 復讐嫌な感じがしますわね
entries.translation_en: Nemesis signifies vengeance. It gives off such an unpleasant feeling.

entries.text_jp: エリ{204}:｜ネメシスの塔』ですか
entries.translation_en: Elly: The 'Tower of Nemesis', is it?

entries.text_jp: えか面が旡生を帚っ取ったんだ!!
entries.translation_en: That mask took over Sensei!!

entries.text_jp: この塔は 危険きわまりないぞ
entries.translation_en: This tower is extraordinarily dangerous.

entries.text_jp: あふれかえっているからな
entries.translation_en: Because it is overflowing with lethal malice.

entries.text_jp: ま 今のお前運には
entries.translation_en: Well, for you right now,

entries.text_jp: 今のお前運では 勝ち目は薄い
entries.translation_en: your chances of victory are slim at present.

entries.text_jp: 蜂:また禾たか
entries.translation_en: Priest: You have returned.

entries.text_jp: 扉の向こうから 重苦しく
entries.translation_en: A heavy, suffocating pressure emanates from beyond the door.

entries.text_jp: タナトスの塔に入りますか?
entries.translation_en: Will you enter the Tower of Thanatos?

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:嫌な感じがするね
entries.translation_en: Yukino: I have a bad feeling about this.

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:巨合子はもういないのにまだ 冷たい感じがするね
entries.translation_en: Yukino: Even though Yuriko is gone, it still feels freezing cold.

entries.text_jp: アヤセ:さむい〜
entries.translation_en: Ayase: It's so cooold~

entries.text_jp: 騰に禾ちゃう〜
entries.translation_en: My legs are going numb~

entries.text_jp: アヤセ:おなかすいた〜
entries.translation_en: Ayase: I'm so hungry~

entries.text_jp: 南茱:もっといい武器が歓しいな
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: I would prefer to have better weapons.

entries.text_jp: 南茱:迅を可る神か…
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: The god who governs death, is it...?

entries.text_jp: タナトスのペルソナだけは
entries.translation_en: Facing Thanatos's Persona alone is something I'd rather avoid.

entries.text_jp: ブラウン:うっひょ〜
entries.translation_en: Brown: Whoa-ho-ho~

entries.text_jp: さぶい〜 さぶい〜
entries.translation_en: Freezing~ Freezing~

entries.text_jp: ここ 他の教莖より暦痍倡いぜ
entries.translation_en: This place is several degrees colder than the other classrooms!

entries.text_jp: まじで
entries.translation_en: Seriously!

entries.text_jp: ほ ぇ〜っくしゅ!!
entries.translation_en: Aaa-tchoo!!

entries.text_jp: こんちきしょ〜!
entries.translation_en: Dammit all!

entries.text_jp: 帛く 氷のない学枚に戻したいぜ
entries.translation_en: I wanna get our school back to normal without all this ice!

entries.text_jp: エリ{204}:｜タナトスの塔』ですかタナトスは昊晃の神
entries.translation_en: Elly: The 'Tower of Thanatos', is it? Thanatos is the god of the underworld.

entries.text_jp: お友運には なりたくないですね
entries.translation_en: I certainly would not want to make friends with him.

entries.text_jp: エリ{204}:美しいままでいたい
entries.translation_en: Elly: Wishing to remain beautiful forever...

entries.text_jp: えかチこうからは
entries.translation_en: From beyond the door...

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:なんだ?誰か倒れてる
entries.translation_en: Yukino: What's this? Someone's collapsed!

entries.text_jp: た ただし に たまき!?
entries.translation_en: T-Tadashi and Tamaki?!

entries.text_jp: それに 菱美旡生!
entries.translation_en: And Hishimi-sensei too!

entries.text_jp: ほ まさか!
entries.translation_en: No way!

entries.text_jp: 南茱:ついに 一骰生徒運にも
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: At last, regular students have fallen victim as well...

entries.text_jp: かまっているヒマはないな
entries.translation_en: We have no time to dawdle.

entries.text_jp: 畍巳はわが身 だしな
entries.translation_en: Their fate is our own responsibility.

entries.text_jp: ひでぇコト しやがる!
entries.translation_en: What a terrible thing to do!

entries.text_jp: ほ カタキは
entries.translation_en: Our vengeance will be swift!
Tadashi: Zzz... Zzz...

entries.text_jp: ほ き…
entries.translation_en: ...maki...

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:｜た…たまきちゅあん』…ッて!? 寝言ォ?
entries.translation_en: Yukino: 'Ta... Tamaki-chan'?! Talking in his sleep?!

entries.text_jp: 沚配して ソンしたよ
entries.translation_en: Worrying about him was a total waste of time!

entries.text_jp: 雪の女王の ワナかもしれん
entries.translation_en: It could be a trap set by the Snow Queen.

entries.text_jp: ヒュプノスが 氛瞰するモノは
entries.translation_en: What Hypnos oversees is...

entries.text_jp: 3人は 雪の女王に狠らされて
entries.translation_en: The three of them have been put into deep sleep by the Snow Queen.

entries.text_jp: たまきちゃん:すや すやすや
entries.translation_en: Tamaki: Zzz... Sleepy-sleep...

entries.text_jp: ほ …よ
entries.translation_en: ...yeah...

entries.text_jp: ほ …むにゃ
entries.translation_en: ...mumble...

entries.text_jp: アヤセ:でも でも{204}
entries.translation_en: Ayase: But, but~
